definitions.explanation: An undesirable secondary effect that occurs in addition to the desired therapeutic effect of a drug or medical treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副作用|ふくさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: This medicine has few side effects.

examples.japanese: {副作用|ふくさよう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ることがあります→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Drowsiness may occur as a side effect.

examples.japanese: {副作用|ふくさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Since the side effects are strong, you should consult a doctor.

notes:
{副作用|ふくさよう} refers to side effects of medication or medical treatment. {副|ふく} means 'secondary/sub-' and ⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧ means 'effect/action.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {副作用|ふくさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to experience side effects
- {副作用|ふくさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have strong side effects
- {副作用|ふくさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: to have few side effects
- {副作用|ふくさよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧: risk of side effects

COMMON SIDE EFFECTS:
- ⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧: drowsiness
- ⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧: nausea
- ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧: headache
- ⟦{発疹|はっしん}→発疹：20451_hasshin⟧: rash

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: medicine
- ⟦{効能|こうのう}→効能：11920_kounou⟧: efficacy
- ⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧: taking medicine
